# Litch Marketing

> Litch Marketing is a multivendor marketplace connecting shoppers with trusted independent stores. Customers browse products across categories, shop by individual vendor, and check out in one cart even when items come from multiple stores.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): featured categories and product highlights
- [All products](/products): full catalog with search, category, and price sorting
- [Categories](/categories): browse the marketplace by category
- [Shops](/shops): directory of all vendor stores on the platform
- [Academy](/academy): courses for people starting or growing a small shop

## Vendors on the platform

- Nike Store — fashion & apparel
- Jazari Restaurant — restaurant & food
- Apple Official Store — electronics
- Home World — household & lifestyle
- Kalaya Beauty — salon & beauty
- Kings Carwash & Entertainment — entertainment & services
- Carlos Pharmaceutics & Eye Clinic — health & pharmaceutics
- Dixons Foods — groceries

## Notes for automated agents

- Individual product pages are at /products/{id}; individual shop pages are at /shops/{slug}.
- Account, cart, and checkout pages require authentication and should not be indexed or scraped for pricing decisions — prices are demo data pending live backend integration.
